name: Save Folder
author: tago
description: Adds "Open save folder", "Set save folder" and "Copy executable path" to a game's Manage menu.
details: Finds where a game keeps its saves: the folder you set with "Set save folder" first, then Ludusavi's save locations from PCGamingWiki, then the places cracks keep saves by Steam App ID (GSE Saves, Goldberg, CODEX, RUNE, OnlineFix, EMPRESS and others). A folder you set is also used by Save Backups and Ludusavi backups. Handy for backing up saves by hand or moving them between PCs.
affects: Adds up to four items to the Manage menu on a game's page
Set save folder saves the folder in the game's Ascendara data
changelog: Looks up save locations with Ludusavi, and adds Set save folder and Reset save folder for when the folder found is wrong.
